answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by requiring each identity to post a costly, non-refundable stake before its votes or attestations count. Like a captain funding a long voyage, no swarm can cheaply conjure a thousand faces when each one burns real collateral. Reputation then crystallizes slowly from attested work rather than instant minting, so the shadowy umber fringes full of unstaked clones are simply down-weighted by honest peers who trust proven history over raw headcount.
